name: python-crdt
title: Replicas that converge without asking anyone
blurb: State-based CRDTs with their laws checked instead of assumed: grow-only and paired counters (where max() over signed counts is shown to lose a concurrent decrement), a last-write-wins register that is honest about the write it drops, and an observed-remove set that keeps an add it never saw. Idempotence, commutativity and associativity are run over real states, and a shuffled, duplicated gossip simulation is what proves the merge converges.
default_description: Merge replicated state, and show what each merge guarantees.
